Below is how I got my Techblog started.
sudo dnf install hugo hugo version dnf info hugo hugo new site techblog cd ./techblog git init git submodule add https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod.git themes/PaperMod rm hugo.toml nvim hugo.yml Content types 3 types of content , Blog(posts), Guides, and Projects.
hugo new content posts/my-first-post.md --> content/posts/my-first-post.md hugo new content guides/proton-drive.md --> content/guides/proton-drive.md hugo new content projects/pico-dice.md --> content/projects/pico-dice.md
summary:
Below is how I got my Techblog started.

sudo dnf install hugo
hugo version
dnf info hugo
hugo new site techblog
cd ./techblog
git init
git submodule add https://github.com/adityatelange/hugo-PaperMod.git themes/PaperMod
rm hugo.toml
nvim hugo.yml

Content types

3 types of content , Blog(posts), Guides, and Projects.

hugo new content posts/my-first-post.md --> content/posts/my-first-post.md

hugo new content guides/proton-drive.md --> content/guides/proton-drive.md

hugo new content projects/pico-dice.md --> content/projects/pico-dice.md
